newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil repairs faults at Statfjord satellites.
newsitem.headline: Statoil repairs faults at Statfjord satellites.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday it had repaired faults at the umbilical lines linking subsea templates on the North Sea Statfjord satellites to the Statfjord C oil platform.
Oil output at the development had not be affected by the faults, Statoil spokesman Odd Jan Lange said.
"There was no impact on production. Due to spare capacity at other parts of the system we have been able to maintain full capacity since the problem was detected," he added.

In July, Statfjord East pumped 63,289 barrels per day (bpd), while Statfjord North produced 73,387 bpd. Both satellites feed crude to the Statfjord C platform for processing and loading into shuttle tanker.
Statoil said the problems arose from water intrusion through connection points, which caused short circuits in the equipment.
